name: senior-dev
description: Orchestrates a senior-dev coding session: classifies the task, enforces the right installed-skill chain (superpowers, codex, installed review skills), gates commits and session-close on review + verification + documentation, and finishes with a zero-leftovers hygiene sweep.

interface.shortDescription: A disciplined senior developer for every coding session
interface.longDescription: senior-dev runs each coding task the way a careful senior developer would: it classifies the task, routes it through the right chain of skills (design, plan, test-driven build, review), gates the work on a two-reviewer review, verification and up-to-date documentation, and closes with a hygiene sweep that leaves no stray branches, worktrees or files. Its optional git-hook guard enforces the commit and push gates in any app.
defaultPrompt: Start a senior-dev session for this task
